title: Game Server Catalog
description: A curated catalog of dedicated game servers. One object per game.

id.description: Stable slug. Also used in gamehostcloud.com/games/<id> URLs.

family.description: Deployment/runtime family the server belongs to (e.g. steamcmd-linux-source, minecraft-java).

steamAppId.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server, when one exists.

defaultPort.description: Conventional default game port; 0 = no fixed port.
